text_block_list.text: —The 'Arima Kinen' was drawing near.

"Ever since Christmas, I've only received 
brief, simple reports from Chrono 
Genesis."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Even when we're apart, Trainer's 
feelings are always with me...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Trainer... guided my running...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(That's why... in my running, there will 
always be my Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...We will carve our history together... 
The 'Arima Kinen'—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm all alone, I will win...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Substitute Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I think my conditioning is just 
fine. Now if only... I could relax just a 
little more.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I really can't keep going on like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"This isn't how our Arima Kinen is 
supposed to be."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Without you, Chrono-san— we could never 
become a bouquet that brings color to this 
era.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
We must ensure that your flower blooms 
beautifully, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All we can do now is charge straight 
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I just can't bear to watch Chrono like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right, strike while the iron is 
hot. Let's head out right now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—So, Trainer. Do you think you'll be able 
to come to the Arima Kinen?

"Loves Only You, Gran Alegria, and Curren 
Bouquetd'or stood surrounding the bed, 
demanding answers."
choice_data_list:
They said I'll be discharged after the new 
year, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Aren't you jumping the gun a bit?
choice_data_list: I want to move it up!

text_block_list.text:
Rehabilitation finally started the other 
day. However, they made it very clear that 
I won't be discharged as long as the pain 
remains severe...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We want Chrono-chan to run her absolute 
best in the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
However... at this rate, we can't hope to 
be in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: You need a Trainer, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
For your sake, Chrono-san— and for the 
generation we are building together.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you must not push yourself too 
hard! Chrono-chan will be sad if you do! 
Please follow the doctor's instructions 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, I talked with the community committee 
members. How about a temporary outing?
choice_data_list:
Going out! If that's it, there might still 
be a chance...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then it's a plan! Let's work hard on rehab 
with the goal of going out together♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If there is anything we can do to help— 
please let us know.

Even though they're also running in the 
Arima Kinen, rather than caring about 
winning or losing, they just want to have 
the greatest race possible with Chrono 
Genesis...!
Our feelings are the same! In that case—
choice_data_list: Um, Gran, I have a favor to ask...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Chrono-chan! Have a 
mile-tastic day!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Then let's run side-by-side!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-what...? Run... tandem 
together...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't been able to do proper tandem 
runs, right? Finding matching partners is 
the Trainer's job, after all."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: B-But... is that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, I'm aiming for a 
three-division sweep. Conquering GⅠ races 
across Sprint, Mile, and Medium 
distances!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why training alongside Chrono-chan 
will be 80 miles helpful for tackling 
medium distances!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry about holding back on our 
account.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We want to compete against Chrono-chan 
when she's in peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a difficult situation. But—I 
want you to make the best adjustments you 
possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And—let's engrave our generation's running 
into history at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Thank... you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Gran-chan. I'd be honored to train 
alongside you...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can adapt to any race pace! 
Nothing is impossible for the genius Gran 
Alegria!
And... on the day of the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm going to go... win 
consecutive Grand Prix titles!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Chrono! We've been waiting for you! Thanks 
for running today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"We've got your back! Let's deliver our 
absolute best run to Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Why...? Even though everyone is 
cheering so warmly for me...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Once I step into the paddock...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Why am I feeling so anxious...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer isn't here... The reality of 
it... suddenly hit me so hard...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The ground feels like it's going to 
collapse beneath me any second...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't let myself waver...! Calm your 
mind. Gather your fighting spirit...——"

"Chrono Genesis leisurely turned her gaze 
toward me."

—A signal to ignite our fighting spirit. I 
clench my fist and nod resolutely.
choice_data_list:
Win and etch your name in history with 
back-to-back Grand Prix victories!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...T-Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: R-Really...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, no way! It's a miracle!! I'm so 
happy for you, Chrono!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer—we made it in time, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I can run alongside Chrono-chan 
at her absolute best♪

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...That's an ear-splitting, thunderous 
applause, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Listening to this warms my heart! That 
applause makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is no time to let my emotions 
get the better of me!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'll be fine. I have Grass-san's 
teachings with me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Come on, Chrono-chan! Let's both give it 
our absolute best run!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And we'll show them! The brilliance unique 
to our generation!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The history we build... as the hoofprints 
of the 'Strongest Tiara Generation.'"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back Grand Prix victories—I will 
make it happen!
